data.title: 新条茜 · 教室中心的完美微笑
data.description: 课间教室，茜一手托腮，用恰到好处的亲切笑容回应画外的话语。另一只手在合起的笔记旁无意识地转着橡皮，午间光线照出她完美表情与小动作之间的差异。
data.action: 课间教室，茜一手托腮，用恰到好处的亲切笑容回应画外的话语
data.promptProse: Akane Shinjou supports her cheek with one hand and answers an off-frame classmate with a carefully friendly smile. Her other hand turns an eraser beside the closed notebook, revealing restlessness beneath the composed face. A blue cardigan covers her white school blouse in the medium portrait. Noon window light falls across her face and desk, picking out the eraser's moving edge while the chair and classroom rows recede in softer shade.
